getById.description: Gets an entry from 'employees' by its primary key

create.sql: INSERT INTO employees(department_id, boss_id, name_emp, start_date, end_date, salary, fee, email, password, position) VALUES ($department_id, $boss_id, $name_emp, $start_date, $end_date, $salary, $fee, $email, $password, $position)

update.description: Updates an existing entry in 'employees' by its primary key
update.sql: UPDATE employees SET department_id = $department_id, boss_id = $boss_id, name_emp = $name_emp, start_date = $start_date, end_date = $end_date, salary = $salary, fee = $fee, email = $email, password = $password, position = $position WHERE employee_id = $employee_id
